summary_for_children: Al-'Alaq means The Clinging Substance. Its first ayahs were the first revelation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created, who taught by the pen.
world_title: Recite! The Pen and the Clinging Substance
environment_concept: A rocky hill rises over the path with a small cave high on its side. The surah does not describe this place; the cave follows the hadith of the first revelation and is labelled as such. Below, a writing desk holds a reed pen, ink and blank paper (96:4), and a quiet terrace invites prostration (96:19). No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A steep hill with a cave mouth, a writing desk with reed pen, inkwell and paper, a prayer terrace.
